summary: Implemented one deterministic fixture-only lifecycle command that runs raw market intake, normalization, scoring, review, paper order planning, paper execution ledger generation, and portfolio/exposure summarization in one offline paper chain.
limitations: Fixture-only lifecycle command; no live markets, prices, APIs, or external metadata are fetched.
Execution fixture prices are aligned deterministically to raw-intake market IDs for this lifecycle command.
Paper fills, settlement, exposure, and PnL are offline review calculations only.
No runtime integration, dispatcher/run_codex, prompt automation, credentials, wallet access, real orders, live trading, unrelated cleanup, or new validation layer was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-012: add offline multi-scenario paper lifecycle replay to compare filled, not-filled, open, and settled position outcomes.
